question.en:
Assertion (A): Any Act placed in the Ninth Schedule of the Constitution enjoys absolute and perpetual immunity from judicial review under all circumstances.
Reason (R): In I.R. Coelho (2007), the Supreme Court ruled that laws added to the Ninth Schedule on or after April 24, 1973 are subject to the test of the Basic Structure.
question.ta:
